caption: Figure 1: The architectural evolvement of mainstream hypervisors (a →b →c) that gradually demote hypervisor functionalities out of kernel mode and the delegated virtualization proposed by this paper (d). U and K represent user mode and kernel mode; H and V are hypervisor mode and virtualization mode

templates.why_chosen: Medium-confidence matrix exemplar of four lettered panels arranged left to right to show a historical progression, each a swimlane stack of privilege-mode rows, with one legend at the top shared by all four.
templates.what_to_learn: When variants show an evolution rather than a static comparison, order the lettered panels left to right to match that history, encode privilege or execution mode as horizontal lanes inside every panel, and keep the arrow-meaning legend at the top since it applies to every panel below it.
